Senses.Explanation: The first half of the paired saying: the humane see it and call it humane, while the wise call it wise. Dahui Zonggao quotes the formula in a case later appraised by Tianyin Yuanxiu; Tian'an Sheng applies it after his own hall remarks; an unnamed layman puts its paired wording to Sanyi Mingyu as a question.
